LESSON: HADITH ON BRUSHING TEETH

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Hadith 2.2 Hadith on Etiquette of Eating (3 Lessons) By the end of the sub-stran
Topic 2.3: Hadith on brushing teeth

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Hadith on brushing teeth. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: When do you brush your teeth?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. read the selected hadith on brushing teeth for the promotion of oral hygiene
2. practise brushing teeth as an act of ibadah
3. appreciate the importance of brushing teeth to earn rewards from Allah (S.W.T.)

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: HADITH ON BRUSHING TEETH
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION · Grade: Grade 4
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Hadith on brushing teeth helps you succeed in ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

KEY FACTS: HADITH ON BRUSHING TEETH
Study Hadith on brushing teeth like a learner textbook page: meaning → examples → practice → check.
Replace teacher words with your own words.
If a step is unclear, rewrite it shorter and try again.

PART 1: Read the selected hadith on brushing teeth for the promotion of oral hygiene

What this means
In this part you learn to read the selected hadith on brushing teeth for the promotion of oral hygiene. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: read the selected hadith on brushing teeth for the promotion of oral hygiene.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Value in action: Show how “Hadith on brushing teeth” looks when you treat a classmate kindly.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can read the selected hadith on brushing teeth for the promotion of oral hygiene. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Practise brushing teeth as an act of ibadah

What this means
In this part you learn to practise brushing teeth as an act of ibadah. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: practise brushing teeth as an act of ibadah.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Story link: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Hadith on brushing teeth in your own words.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can practise brushing teeth as an act of ibadah. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 3: Appreciate the importance of brushing teeth to earn rewards from Allah (S.W.T.)

What this means
In this part you learn to appreciate the importance of brushing teeth to earn rewards from Allah (S.W.T.). You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: appreciate the importance of brushing teeth to earn rewards from Allah (S.W.T.).
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Daily habit: Choose one good action to practise today because of this lesson.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can appreciate the importance of brushing teeth to earn rewards from Allah (S.W.T.). Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Hadith on brushing teeth is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Show how “Hadith on brushing teeth” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: read the selected hadith on brushing teeth for the promotion of oral hygiene)

Example 2: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Hadith on brushing teeth in your own words. (skill: practise brushing teeth as an act of ibadah)

Example 3: Choose one good action to practise today because of this lesson. (skill: appreciate the importance of brushing teeth to earn rewards from Allah (S.W.T.))

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Hadith on brushing teeth to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: read the selected hadith on brushing teeth for the promotion of oral hygiene.
3. Practise this skill: practise brushing teeth as an act of ibadah.
4. Practise this skill: appreciate the importance of brushing teeth to earn rewards from Allah (S.W.T.).
5. Make one local Kenya example of Hadith on brushing teeth from your county, market, farm, or school.
6. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Hadith on brushing teeth: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 4 learner study Hadith on brushing teeth?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. When do you brush your teeth?
2. Why do you brush your teeth?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Hadith on brushing teeth means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: read the selected hadith on brushing teeth for the promotion of oral hygiene.
5. Be able to: practise brushing teeth as an act of ibadah.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
